# mtg-mcp

> A C# MCP server that gives LLMs grounded Magic: The Gathering card, deck,
> source, and statistical evidence plus explicit deck operations.

This file is a map of the repository for language models. `AGENTS.md` holds
the rules for working here; current code, tests, and checked-in configuration
win over any doc. Keep this file a short index, not a second rulebook or a
status log.

## Start here

- [README](README.md): Local deck, Scryfall, Archidekt, Playgroup, Spellbook, exact statistics, and seeded simulation (`stats_simulate`) tools, the three workflow prompts, configuration, and development commands.
- [Agent instructions](AGENTS.md): Rules, architecture boundaries, commands, and worktree conventions.
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): Bootstrap, build, and change expectations.
- [Taskfile](Taskfile.yml): Supported local and CI operations; run `task --list`.
- [North star](docs/north-star.md): Product mission, evidence hierarchy, and non-goals.
- [Design goals](docs/design-goals.md): Architecture, quality, testing, and MCP principles.
- [Rewrite guide](docs/rewrite-guide.md): Lasting product and architecture boundaries from the evidence-first rewrite.

## Architecture

- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): Project, data, evidence, and write boundaries.
- [Adapters](docs/adapters.md): Scryfall, Archidekt, Playgroup, Spellbook, and Moxfield boundaries.
- [Toolsets](docs/toolsets.md): Tool-group selection, credential gating, operation modes, common profiles, and the workflow prompts.
- [Output control](docs/output-control.md): Card response formats (`concise`, `standard`, `full`), the 40,000-byte result size limit, and the historical `detailLevel` levels.
- [Heuristic models](docs/heuristic-models.md): Constraints for experimental work outside the stable surface.
- [Versioning](docs/versioning.md): How versions and public changes are handled.

## Agent docs

- [Agent workflow](docs/llms/agent-workflow.md): How to inspect, plan, edit, validate, and hand off changes.
- [Repository operations](docs/llms/repo-operations.md): Task-based command policy.
- [C# practices](docs/llms/csharp-best-practices.md): Repository-specific C# and .NET conventions.
- [Plans](docs/llms/plans/README.md): Durable ordinary implementation plans.
- [Plan-Led Changes](docs/llms/plcs/README.md): PLC lifecycle, readiness, and authorization rules.
- [Templates](docs/llms/templates/README.md): Ordinary-plan and PLC templates.

## Optional

- [Potential features](docs/potential-features.md): Deferred ideas outside the stable surface.
- [Rewrite program](docs/llms/plcs/completed/evidence-first-mcp-rewrite-program/README.md): The overall rewrite rules and child-packet list.
- [Capability toolsets](docs/llms/plcs/completed/mcp-capability-toolsets/README.md): Design history for startup-selected tool groups and profiles.
- [Local deck store](docs/llms/plcs/completed/local-deck-store/README.md): Design history for deck contracts, SQLite lifecycle, and tools.
- [Manual deck interchange](docs/llms/plcs/completed/manual-deck-interchange/README.md): Design history for native JSON, plain text, and manual provider export files.
- [Contract and adapter hardening](docs/llms/plcs/completed/mcp-contract-and-adapter-hardening/README.md): Design history for exact identity matching and adapter boundaries.
- [Exact deck statistics](docs/llms/plcs/completed/exact-deck-statistics/README.md): Design history for the exact-math tools.
- [Scryfall card data and evidence](docs/llms/plcs/completed/scryfall-corpus-and-evidence/README.md): Design history for card-data install, API cache, replay, and tag evidence.
- [Archidekt synchronization](docs/llms/plcs/completed/archidekt-deck-sync/README.md): Design history for deck, folder, snapshot, and pull/push sync.
- [Playgroup public API](docs/llms/plcs/completed/playgroup-public-api/README.md): Design history for documented Playgroup operations and write guards.
- [Commander Spellbook evidence](docs/llms/plcs/completed/commander-spellbook-evidence/README.md): Design history for the opt-in Spellbook tools.
- [Deterministic deck categorization](docs/llms/plcs/completed/deterministic-deck-categorization/README.md): Design history for caller-configured tag rules.
- [Rewrite stabilization](docs/llms/plcs/completed/rewrite-stabilization-cutover/README.md): Package, documentation, release, and rollback records for the rewrite cutover.
- [Deckbuilding evolution](docs/llms/plcs/completed/evidence-first-deckbuilding-evolution/README.md): Ownership cleanup, toolchain update, source decisions, tag repair, and the on-curve estimate.
- [Completed PLC index](docs/llms/plcs/completed/README.md): Every completed packet.
